comment:
* Provides APIs for the supplementary service settings using IMS (Ut interface).
 * It is created from 3GPP TS 24.623 (XCAP(XML Configuration Access Protocol)
 * over the Ut interface for manipulating supplementary services).
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: CDIV_CF_UNCONDITIONAL
variables.comment:
* CDIV (Communication Diversion, 3GPP TS 24.604)
     *     actions: target, no reply timer

variables.name: CDIV_CF_NOT_LOGGED_IN
variables.comment: (CDIV using condition not-registered) to the same target.

variables.name: CB_BOIC_EXHC
variables.comment: Barring of Outgoing International Calls - excluding Home Country

variables.name: CB_BIC_WR
variables.comment: Barring of Incoming Calls - when roaming

variables.name: CB_BIC_ACR
variables.comment: Barring of Anonymous Communication Rejection (ACR) - a particular case of ICB service

variables.name: CB_BA_MO
variables.comment: Barring of Outgoing Services (Service Code 333 - 3GPP TS 22.030 Table B-1)

variables.name: CB_BA_MT
variables.comment: Barring of Incoming Services (Service Code 353 - 3GPP TS 22.030 Table B-1)

methods.name: public void queryCallBarring(int cbType, Message result)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves the configuration of the call barring.
     * The return value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is an array of {@link ImsSsInfo}.

methods.name: public void queryCallBarring(int cbType, Message result, int serviceClass)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves the configuration of the call barring for specified service class.
     * The return value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is an array of {@link ImsSsInfo}.

methods.name: public void queryCallForward(int condition, String number, Message result)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves the configuration of the call forward.
     * The return value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is an array of {@link ImsCallForwardInfo}.

methods.name: public void queryCallWaiting(Message result)
methods.comment:
* Retrieves the configuration of the call waiting.
     * The return value of ((AsyncResult)result.obj) is an array of {@link ImsSsInfo}.

methods.name: public void updateCallBarring(int cbType, int action, Message result, String[] barrList)
methods.comment: * Modifies the configuration of the call barring.

methods.name: public void updateCallBarring(int cbType, int action, Message result, String[] barrList, int serviceClass)
methods.comment: * Modifies the configuration of the call barring for specified service class.

methods.name: public void updateCallBarring(int cbType, int action, Message result, String[] barrList, int serviceClass, String password)
methods.comment: * Modifies the configuration of the call barring for specified service class with password.

methods.name: public void updateCallForward(int action, int condition, String number, int serviceClass, int timeSeconds, Message result)
methods.comment: * Modifies the configuration of the call forward.

methods.name: public void updateCallWaiting(boolean enable, int serviceClass, Message result)
methods.comment: * Modifies the configuration of the call waiting.

methods.name: public void updateCLIR(int clirMode, Message result)
methods.comment: * Updates the configuration of the CLIR supplementary service.

methods.name: public void updateCLIP(boolean enable, Message result)
methods.comment: * Updates the configuration of the CLIP supplementary service.

methods.name: public void updateCOLR(int presentation, Message result)
methods.comment: * Updates the configuration of the COLR supplementary service.

methods.name: public void updateCOLP(boolean enable, Message result)
methods.comment: * Updates the configuration of the COLP supplementary service.

methods.name: public void registerForSuppServiceIndication(Handler handler, int event, Object object)
methods.comment:
* Register for UNSOL_ON_SS indications.
     * @param handler the {@link Handler} that is notified when there is an ss indication.
     * @param event  Supplimentary service indication event.
     * @param Object user object.

methods.name: public void unregisterForSuppServiceIndication(Handler handler)
methods.comment:
* Deregister for UNSOL_ON_SS indications.
     * @param handler the {@link Handler} that is notified when there is an ss indication.
